description: The posted results of one ClinicalTrials.gov trial — participant flow, baseline, every outcome measure as a table, adverse events — as Markdown from the stored record, capped at max_chars, outcome titles listed; library_read("nct:…", section: <title>) returns one measure whole. has_results false when the registry holds none. A missing trial is added first.

nct.description: The NCT ID: "nct:05173896", "NCT05173896" or the eight digits.

name: library_clinicaltrials_get_study_results
